description: This file defines a React component for displaying a list of companies, utilizing react-admin components and Material UI for UI layout. It includes components for filtering, pagination, sorting, exporting, and creating new companies.

methods.name: CompanyList
methods.description: Main component that initializes the list view, retrieves user identity, and renders the layout.

methods.name: CompanyListLayout
methods.description: Handles layout rendering for the company list, including filters, title, toolbar, image list, and pagination.

methods.name: CompanyListActions
methods.description: Defines actions available in the toolbar such as sorting, exporting, and creating a new company.
